overview: S3E is the one scoreboard packet anticheats actually consume and produce. Grim reads the outbound team stream into per-entity team state that its collision predicates use; intave rewrites the collision rule on outbound team packets and emits team packets to hide fake-player nametags; Shard's monitor emits team packets to render the target name tag and watches for conflicting team traffic. Photon's Teaming is the only flagging check in the domain and it is driven by Bukkit events, not the packet. The rest of the corpus is noise: Rammelkast and AntiCheatPlus match the 'AntiCheat Team' license header on every file, NCP's CollisionUtil reads the Bukkit scoreboard API, and Negativity plus Artemis only register the packet class.

checks.name: TeamHandler (Grim)
checks.purpose: Keep a transaction-ordered mirror of the client's team state so entity checks know the collision and push rules between players and entities.
checks.how_it_works: TeamHandler is a PacketSendListener on PacketType.Play.Server.TEAMS. On each S3E it wraps the packet, reads the team name, and schedules a real-time task at the last transaction id so the update applies at the same tick the client processes it. CREATE builds a new EntityTeam, REMOVE drops it, and the other modes update the stored team with the collision rule from the packet. EntityTeam maps members to the team by UUID, and MovementTicker plus EntityPredicates consult it to decide whether an entity can push the player.
checks.detects: Nothing directly. It feeds collision semantics: team-based collision rules are read consistently because the mirror is transaction-ordered, so push-based exploits cannot desync it.
checks.variations: CheckManager registers the handler per player (CheckManager.java line 119). No other anticheat mirrors team state for physics; the collision-rule consumers are unique to Grim's simulation.

checks.name: Teaming (Photon)
checks.purpose: Flag UHC players who cooperate by clustering, the teaming cheat domain that S3E team membership normally exposes.
checks.how_it_works: Every 5 seconds the check builds a 3D RTree of eligible players (adventure or survival mode, out of combat, outside configured safe zones and WorldGuard no-PVP regions), then clusters players within a configurable proximity range who can see each other. Any cluster larger than the allowed size flags every member with a violation level equal to the surplus. The corpus hit is the team domain: the check never parses S3E and never reads Bukkit team state.
checks.detects: Players teaming in UHC-style gamemodes: two or more players who move together and avoid PVP.
checks.variations: None in the corpus. Photon's ModuleManager registers the module, and Placeholders exposes its violation level for alert messages.

checks.name: EntityCollisionDisabler (intave)
checks.purpose: Patch outbound team packets so the monitored player stops colliding with entities, a server-side no-collision service.
checks.how_it_works: A HIGHEST-priority ProtocolLib subscription on the outbound SCOREBOARD_TEAM packet rewrites the collision-rule string field to 'never' before the packet reaches the client. Version-dependent field indexes handle the 1.13 and 1.17 wire changes, and on 1.17+ the rule is read from the optional internal structure instead of the top-level string list. Active only on 1.9+ servers where the team packet carries a collision rule.
checks.detects: Nothing cheat-related. It is the anticheat applying a collision exemption through the vanilla team mechanism instead of a per-player flag.
checks.variations: Same anticheat, opposite direction: ScoreboardAccessor and FakePlayerBody emit S3E team packets to hide the fake-player nametag (see the next check).

checks.name: ScoreboardAccessor fake-player nametag (intave)
checks.purpose: Hide the nametag of intave's fake-player bait entities so ESP and nametag features cannot distinguish them from real players.
checks.how_it_works: sendScoreboard builds a PacketPlayOutScoreboardTeam with action 3 (ADD_PLAYERS) that places the fake player profile in a dedicated team, then, when hiding is requested, sends a second team packet with action 2 (UPDATE) that sets nameTagVisibility to NEVER. FakePlayerBody invokes it at spawn (FakePlayerBody.java line 318).
checks.detects: Nothing. The team packets are the bait infrastructure behind the aura and reach checks; the nametag must vanish or the fake entity is trivially spotted.
checks.variations: FakePlayerBody.java owns the spawn flow and FakePlayerEventService loads the accessor by class name for the 1.8 pipeline.

checks.name: Monitor nametag team bridge (Shard)
checks.purpose: Render the monitored target's name tag by emitting its own S3E team packets, and keep that rendering valid against other plugins' team traffic.
checks.how_it_works: ViewTeamPacketBridge builds WrapperPlayServerTeams packets (CREATE, UPDATE, ADD_ENTITIES and REMOVE) whose prefix and suffix carry the rendered tag, with the collision rule and nametag visibility forced to ALWAYS so the monitor's tag never interferes with physics. Its companion ViewTeamConflictObserver listens for outbound S3E at MONITOR priority and, when the session renders above the name, marks the target's tag for rebind whenever another plugin creates a team or adds the target to one.
checks.detects: Nothing. The name-tag rendering is the monitor output channel; the observer exists so a server plugin that manages its own teams does not break the view.

package ac.shard.monitor.view

import ac.shard.monitor.core.ComponentCache
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.PacketEvents
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.PacketWrapper
import com.github.retrooper.packetevents.wrapper.play.server.WrapperPlayServerTeams
import net.kyori.adventure.text.Component
import net.kyori.adventure.text.format.NamedTextColor
import org.bukkit.entity.Player

internal class ViewTeamPacketBridge(private val componentCache: ComponentCache) {
  fun createTeam(viewer: Player, teamName: String, playerName: String, rendered: RenderedTag) {
    val wrapper =
      WrapperPlayServerTeams(
        teamName,
        WrapperPlayServerTeams.TeamMode.CREATE,
        createTeamInfo(rendered),
        listOf(playerName),
      )
    sendPacket(viewer, wrapper)
  }

  fun updateTeam(viewer: Player, teamName: String, rendered: RenderedTag) {
    val wrapper =
      WrapperPlayServerTeams(
        teamName,
        WrapperPlayServerTeams.TeamMode.UPDATE,
        createTeamInfo(rendered),
        emptyList(),
      )
    sendPacket(viewer, wrapper)
  }

  fun rebindEntity(viewer: Player, teamName: String, playerName: String) {
    val wrapper =
      WrapperPlayServerTeams(
        teamName,
        WrapperPlayServerTeams.TeamMode.ADD_ENTITIES,
        null as WrapperPlayServerTeams.ScoreBoardTeamInfo?,
        listOf(playerName),
      )
    sendPacket(viewer, wrapper)
  }

  fun removeTeam(viewer: Player, teamName: String) {
    val wrapper =
      WrapperPlayServerTeams(
        teamName,
        WrapperPlayServerTeams.TeamMode.REMOVE,
        null as WrapperPlayServerTeams.ScoreBoardTeamInfo?,
        emptyList<String>(),
      )
    sendPacket(viewer, wrapper)
  }

  private fun createTeamInfo(rendered: RenderedTag): WrapperPlayServerTeams.ScoreBoardTeamInfo {
    return WrapperPlayServerTeams.ScoreBoardTeamInfo(
      Component.empty(),
      componentCache.component(rendered.prefix),
      componentCache.component(rendered.suffix),
      WrapperPlayServerTeams.NameTagVisibility.ALWAYS,
      WrapperPlayServerTeams.CollisionRule.ALWAYS,
      NamedTextColor.WHITE,
      WrapperPlayServerTeams.OptionData.NONE,
    )
  }

  private fun sendPacket(viewer: Player, packet: PacketWrapper<*>) {
    PacketEvents.getAPI().playerManager.sendPacket(viewer, packet)
  }
}
